items.english: Outside the door, grown dark, a violent sound of rain and wind — a {t:storm}.
notes: Kept as bare perception, no verb of being added beyond dash; storm kept plain for three-way link.

items.english: The parents and child had gathered at the {t:table} under the dark {t:electric-light} hanging by the wall of the narrow room, about to have their supper. Father and mother were still really young. And the child was a chubby round baby girl, just able to stand holding on to the {t:table}.
notes: Table kept same word twice; electric-light kept dim/dark; baby girl stated plainly, address term not yet involved.

items.english: Neither the man nor the woman had yet a single wrinkle in the face. But in the man's hollowed gentle eyes in the shadow of his thick brows there was a look of languid tiredness. And about the woman's dark hair and slight shoulders there was a still deeper sunken tiredness, and a drowsy {t:rest}.
notes: Kept tiredness repeated, not varied; drowsy kept distinct from tired; rest token for yasurakasa.

items.english: The day had ended. The grief and suffering of the day were about to flow into the {t:rest} of night. And they smiled in silence, fixing their eyes on all that was the child.
notes: Smile kept as smile for thread to vision; rest kept for yasurakasa, not peace as theological.

items.english: Standing unsteadily, the child tried with fat short hands round as balls to sweep at the things on the {t:table}, without a gap and far too fast. So smiling, they put all the bowls and the teapot and the aluminum pots under the {t:table}. On the {t:table} there was left only the small spoon the child held and a single small dish.
notes: Smiling kept same; table repeated same word three times; disorder kept physical, not tidied.

items.english: But the child gave a noisy little cry full of joy and banged spoon and dish down on the {t:table}.
notes: Kept noisy joy and banging plain; cry not varied to laugh to keep smile network intact.

data.say: Drafted opening supper tableau plain and warm, keeping storm, table, tiredness, smile and rest linked for vision to detach from.
